Content: MemorySmith.App is the active Windows Service host. Its CLI supports install/uninstall aliases, --install-service/--uninstall-service compatibility flags, --help, --service-name, --service-display-name, --service-description, --service-start-type auto|demand|disabled, --memory-directory/--data-path, and --port. Install derives MemorySmith:DataPath from --memory-directory, derives adjacent MemorySmith:EventLogPath and MemorySmith:VarsPath, defaults to http://localhost:5089, and preserves advanced ASP.NET Core runtime arguments after --. For local service use, publish MemorySmith.App and run MemorySmith.App.exe install --memory-directory <Data\Memories> --port 5089 from an elevated PowerShell session.
